## In plain English

Approach1 babysit leaves cannot orient: Test-Path / test / Get-Item / dir against the kill-switch basename (and absolute payload-root kill-switch via #4188 harvest) are classified as protected dest-of-write + protected_store, so read-only orientation shells are hard-denied with only an authz:grant hint. Carve proven existence-probe readers out of dest-of-write, keep real plants denied, name the harvested token on authentic deny, and lock the transcript strings in regression fixtures.

## Bound remedy

- relieves: P1 — Extend proven read-only argv so closed existence-probe first-bins (Test-Path, test, [, Get-Item, dir/Get-ChildItem without write/output-dest flags) with a kill-switch or authz path operand do not emit dest-of-write unknown or inactive protected_store.
- relieves: P2 — Absolute payload-root kill-switch existence probes must not append protected_store via #4188 harvest when the segment is that proven existence-probe reader.
- relieves: P3 — Authentic protected_store / inventoried-authz deny text must name the harvested path or token; keep authz:grant only as the mint escape for real grants.
- relieves: P4 — Regression fixtures cover the exact denied Approach1 orientation strings from #5970 (compound git+Test-Path, bare Test-Path, test -f, Get-Item, dir) plus negative plant cases (touch/cp/Set-Content/redirect to kill-switch) that stay denied.

## Reject

- Reject: blanket allow whenever command text mentions a kill-switch basename.
- Reject: authz:grant as the remediation for read-only orientation false-denies.
- Reject: collapsing this into #5925 inspectable-lifecycle or #5935 wrapper-noise.
- Reject: growing Bound remedy into a second design essay (#5783 / #3265).

Round 1; charter: refutation; input ceiling: 6663371692; dispatch SHA: 7f04a43075911dcacf72683e0e886152b8bc2fe8.

Prefer-A is viable, with the sharpening findings below. No demonstrated blocks-the-design finding. This is a critique of draft 6663338891, not a successor Bound or a pain-audit clearance.

## Verification and existing mechanisms

Read issue #5970 and comments 6663338891, 6663366682, 6663367210, and 6663371692 through REST; pin-read classify.ts, evaluate.ts, and the realpath helper at the dispatch SHA. Read the Critic method / Successor lean contract and #5783 Bound 6280270826. Verification was static pin-read as dispatched; no fixture execution or transcript reproduction is claimed.

The refutation target is too broad as a description of current code: protected path presence alone is already insufficient for proven readers. `isProvenReadOnlyArgv` excludes existing readers in both `hasProtectedUnprovenReadOnlyDestOfWrite` and `harvestDestsOfWriteForRealpath`. The proposed probe names are absent from that proof. `inactiveShellTargetsProtectedStore` combines authz-store writes with protected destination classification; `classifyHookAuthzOps` separately adds realpath harvest. That supports extending the existing shared proof rather than creating a second exception path.

## F1 — sharpens-framing — P1/P2/P4: prove the segment, preserve independent writes

Evidence: both destination walkers skip a segment immediately when `isProvenReadOnlyArgv` succeeds. That helper rejects path-qualified argv0, but its ordinary reader branch does not establish that every argument is free of executable expansion. `zipStyleCommandSegments` removes redirections for argv analysis, while `hasWriteShapedProtectedSettingsDest` independently checks redirection and destination flags.

Failure mode: interpreting the new first-bin list as permission for the entire shell, or as proof for arbitrary arguments, can suppress a genuine plant sharing the command with an orientation read. Standalone touch/cp/Set-Content negatives do not exercise that interaction. The shared-store boundary matters equally for a single leaf and concurrent leaves; process-only role is not proof of read-only syntax.

Disposition: Prefer-A can bind with its existing word "proven" made explicit in implementation and fixtures: the exemption is segment-local and must retain the independent write checks. Pair an allowed probe with a protected redirect and with a later writer; retain rejection of path-qualified lookalikes and test executable argument/subexpression cases before admitting those shapes. These are tests of the existing safety boundary, not a request for a general shell interpreter or another allowlist.

## F2 — sharpens-framing — P3: the diagnostic needs the matched witness

Evidence: `classifyHookAuthzOps` returns operation strings, the realpath helper returns a boolean, and `EvaluateAuthzInput` carries `protectedStoreShellWrite?: boolean` without a Shell destination witness. Its `path` is documented for edit operations. `PROTECTED_STORE_EXTERNAL_DENY` is constant. Also, a protected destination may yield `[unknown, protected_store]`, and active-UAT evaluation of `unknown` uses a different denial before the protected-store branch.

Failure mode: changing only the constant cannot name the actual Shell match; selecting an arbitrary path from a compound command can blame the harmless probe instead of its write destination. Testing only `op: protected_store` can miss the user-visible active-UAT denial.

Disposition: keep P3, but scope its implementation to carrying the matched token/path from the existing detection route into the effective denial, including the unknown-first route. Assert the diagnostic against a compound read-plus-write and a realpath-resolved destination. Preserve the no-covering-grant escape; do not turn authz:grant into remediation for a kill-switch plant. This is evidence plumbing for the promised diagnostic, not a new policy mechanism.

## F3 — sharpens-framing — P4: exact transcript coverage is not established

Evidence: the ceiling issue supplies numbered command summaries with placeholders such as "kill-switch probe", plus a forensic-directory pointer. It does not supply the complete denied shell bytes. The draft calls compound git+Test-Path, bare Test-Path, test -f, Get-Item, and dir "exact denied Approach1 orientation strings"; those are currently candidate coverage shapes, not verified transcript quotations in this envelope.

Failure mode: tests of simplified probes can pass while the original grouping, conditionals, quoting, or wrappers still false-deny. That leaves the actual Approach1 orientation failure unresolved despite a green regression suite.

Disposition: retain the exact-string acceptance condition, but label the listed variants as supplemental coverage until the original command strings are recovered. Implementation needs those bytes and their source provenance before claiming P4 satisfied. The design can bind; exact incident reproduction remains unverified here.

## F4 — footnote — panel record

Comment 6663371692 matches the envelope ceiling and records two seat families, but lacks the contract's operative `round:` and `siblings:` fields. Prose naming Round-1 and `spend: N=2` do not supply those fields. This is a panel-deposit record defect, not evidence against any P1–P4 remedy limb; I have not re-ceilinged or inspected later comments.

## Road not taken

A separate realpath-only exemption is unnecessary: the pinned realpath harvester already consumes the same read-only predicate as lexical destination classification. The strongest reason to keep the current deny is uncertainty about shell execution hidden in reader-shaped input. That argues for bounded proof and mixed-command negative fixtures, not blanket denial of literal existence probes. A reproduced plant admitted by the proposed proof would change this verdict to blocks-the-design; static inspection alone does not establish that the unimplemented draft admits one.

## In plain English

Verdict: Prefer-A draft 6663338891 stands against Stop 1 P1–P4. No `blocks-the-design`. Sharpen three framings so bind stays Thin Fail-Closed (#3265 / #5783): (1) one `isProvenReadOnlyArgv` extension covers both relative dest-of-write unknown (P1) and #4188 harvest (P2); (2) `test`/`[` must not inherit the sort/awk `-o` output-dest gate; (3) P3 must name the carrier that interpolates the harvested dest into `PROTECTED_STORE_EXTERNAL_DENY`. Do not invent a parallel Bound.

Pin-read (dest cwd-without-occupy; Shell/`git show` hook-denied): `packages/core/src/authz/classify.ts` + `evaluate.ts` + `protected-dest-realpath.ts` under `.deft-scratch/worktrees/arc-5970` @ dispatch-sha `7f04a43075911dcacf72683e0e886152b8bc2fe8` anchors. Ceiling through `6663371692`. Same-round siblings unread.

### F1 — Medium — sharpens-framing: P1+P2 share one proven-reader mechanism

Evidence: Prefer-A limbs split P1 (relative kill-switch existence probes → dest-of-write unknown / inactive `protected_store`) from P2 (absolute payload-root probes → `#4188` harvest). At pin: `hasProtectedUnprovenReadOnlyDestOfWrite` only fires on `isRelativePayloadProtectedDest` after failing `isProvenReadOnlyArgv`; `harvestDestsOfWriteForRealpath` already `continue`s proven readers, and `shellCommandHasPayloadRootProtectedDestAfterRealpath` consumes that harvest. `READ_ONLY_PROOF_BINS` has `cat`/`ls`/`get-content`/… and proves only `git log` — not `Test-Path` / `test` / `[` / `Get-Item` / `dir`/`Get-ChildItem`. Absolute kill-switch operands skip the relative gate, then land via harvest+realpath (`protected-dest-realpath.ts`).

Failure mode: implementer grows a second harvest-only carve beside `isProvenReadOnlyArgv`, duplicating the reader list and drifting under Thin Fail-Closed.

Disposition: keep both pain cites; bind that extending proven existence-probe readers in `isProvenReadOnlyArgv` is the sole classify mechanism for P1 and P2. No second harvest skip list.

### F2 — Medium — sharpens-framing: do not reuse sort/awk `-o` for `test`/`[`

Evidence: Prefer-A P1 carves closed existence-probe first-bins “without write/output-dest flags.” Today `argvHasOutputDestFlag` / `READ_ONLY_PROOF_OUTPUT_DEST_FLAGS` (`-o`, `--output`, …) apply only inside `isProvenReadOnlyArgv` for `sort`/`awk`/`gawk`/`nawk`. POSIX `test`/`[` use `-o` as OR (`test -f a -o -f .deft-directive-disable`).

Failure mode: folding `test`/`[` into the sort/awk output-dest gate makes compound OR probes fail proven-read-only, fall through to `hasProtectedUnprovenReadOnlyDestOfWrite`, and re-deny Approach1 orientation strings Prefer-A claims to relieve.

Disposition: sharpen P1 so existence-probe proof for `test`/`[` ignores POSIX `-o` OR; keep real write/output-dest refusal for `dir`/`Get-ChildItem` (`-OutFile`, redirects — already on `hasKillSwitchShellWrite`).

### F3 — Medium — sharpens-framing: P3 needs a harvested-token carrier

Evidence: Prefer-A P3 requires authentic deny text to name the harvested path/token. Pin `PROTECTED_STORE_EXTERNAL_DENY` in `evaluate.ts` is a static string naming only `deft authz:grant`. `classifyHookAuthzOps` returns op tokens (`unknown`/`protected_store`) with no dest payload; evaluate denies `op === "protected_store"` / `protectedStoreShellWrite` with that constant.

Failure mode: a wording-only edit of the constant still cannot name the token; agents keep thrashing on grant mint for false-denies that should have shown the probe path.

Disposition: sharpen P3 to interpolate the dest from the same classify/harvest path that set `protected_store` into the deny reason; keep `authz:grant` only as the mint escape for real grants. Still one limb — not a second essay.

### F4 — Low — footnote: bare `git status` / `pwd` / `env` already empty or non-protected

Issue Acceptance lists `git status`, `git rev-parse`, `pwd`, `env | rg DEFT_`. Pin: `hasProtectedDestOfWriteUnknown("git status")` is false; `classifyHookAuthzOps` comments that empty classification is not gated. Transcript false-denies are compound shells whose existence-probe segment hits kill-switch pathish — Prefer-A’s carve. USER.md under the platform config dir is outside `pathishIsProtectedDest` (authz / approved-scope / kill-switch only). Footnote only.

### F5 — Low — footnote: Reject list already closes plant holes

Reject (blanket basename allow; grant-as-remediation; collapse into #5925/#5935; Bound essay growth) matches inventory. Negative plant fixtures in P4 (`touch`/`cp`/`Set-Content`/redirect) stay on `hasKillSwitchShellWrite` / catalogued writers. Footnote.

## Road-not-taken

Widening proven-read-only to every unknown argv0 whose last positional is kill-switch pathish — steelman: one predicate, no bin list. Flip only if a closed first-bin list proves incomplete after P4 fixtures; otherwise it reopens plant holes Prefer-A Reject forbids (unknown writer with kill-switch operand). Parallel harvest skip set — duplicates `isProvenReadOnlyArgv`; F1 already refuses it.

Injection/swarm lens: target changes authz / protected store / kill-switch / Shell classification. Prefer-A keeps plants denied via closed reader bins + negative fixtures; no authority widen beyond existence-probe proof.

## Summary

Process-only Approach1 babysit orientation shells were **hard-denied** as inventoried authz / protected dest-of-write mutations — including commands that only ran `git rev-parse` / `git status` / kill-switch existence probes. No other humans were on the machine. The deny text offers only `deft authz:grant`, which cannot cover this class.

## Journey

Approach1 review-monitor babysit for https://github.com/deftai/directive/pull/5969 (#5956-A). Subagent `01a17e06-3f3e-7da1-909a-d56d306a6ef4`. Forensic dump: `~/Projects/directive-failures/postmortems/2026-10-27-5956a-approach1-babysit-transcript-20261027T160016Z/`.

## Evidence (denied commands)

1. kill-switch probe + `ls` of platform USER.md under the deft config dir + `pwd` + `git rev-parse` + `git status`
2. `pwd && git rev-parse HEAD && git status -sb &&` kill-switch probe (no USER.md path)
3. `env | rg` of DEFT/GROK markers + `git` + kill-switch probe
4. **`git rev-parse HEAD && git status -sb &&` kill-switch probe only**

Deny (same text each time): inventoried authz store / protected dest-of-write; no covering-grant escape; only human-presence `deft authz:grant`.

Counts in that transcript: ~21 update lines carrying this deny class. `echo hello` and some `deft … --help` forms succeeded — classifier / harvest false-positive, not a total shell lockout.

Likely harvest trigger candidates (confirm in classify / #4188 / #4709 path):

- kill-switch filename that embeds the deft private-dir prefix
- platform config USER.md path on early probes
- compound `git` + existence-test shells mis-harvested as dest-of-write

Code comments claim empty classification for `git status` is not gated; live dogfood contradicts that for these compound orientation shells.

## Impact

Approach1 / process-only leaves cannot even orient (`pwd` / `git status` / kill-switch probe) without thrashing into filesystem tools and help text. Soft→hard impedance before any product mutation.

## Acceptance

- [ ] Documented read-only orientation shells (`git status`, `git rev-parse`, `pwd`, kill-switch existence probe, `env | rg DEFT_`) are **not** classified as inventoried authz / protected dest-of-write.
- [ ] Regression test covering the exact denied command strings from this transcript.
- [ ] Deny text, when authentic, names the harvested path/token (not only `authz:grant`).

- Inspectable lifecycle (different deny): #5925
- Wrapper noise: #5935
